verdict: Organic signals declining across all brands; paid channels remain off.
narrative: Across all three businesses this period, Google Business Profile was the only active channel, generating a combined 399 total actions — 15 calls, 278 direction requests, and 102 web clicks — with zero paid spend and zero leads across 28 days. GBP engagement fell sharply in the most recent week: down 47% for Forte Precision Metals, 23% for Advance Grinding Services, and 30% for O'Hare Precision Metals, while organic search clicks declined 57%, 28%, and 46% respectively over the same span. The drop in the final 3–4 days of the window is confirmed across all three brands, with actions and clicks reaching zero, pointing to a real visibility pullback. Several foundational work items — including CRM data reconciliation, a web and SEO root-cause fix, and outreach sequence launches — remain overdue and are being escalated now; resolving these is the direct path to turning paid channels back on and rebuilding lead flow.
